name: Behçet Disease
definition: Multisystem inflammatory disorder characterized by recurrent oral ulcers with variable genital, ocular, vascular, neurological and joint manifestations.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical with organ-directed testing and exclusion of mimics.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Ocular, vascular or neurological disease needs urgent specialist treatment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Mukha/Rakta/Shotha phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Multisystem inflammatory disorder characterized by recurrent oral ulcers with variable genital, ocular, vascular, neurological and joint manifestations.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
